inherits: C036 same-language merge and separator extraction
C039.1 single-head Horn projection and general Horn-CNF obstruction
exact_object: A deterministically discovered forest of maximal pure affine and pure single-head Horn modules with logarithmic per-module shared-variable interfaces

discovery.affine_modules: connected components of the affine factor-variable incidence subgraph
discovery.horn_modules: connected components of the Horn factor-variable incidence subgraph, admitted only when each positive head occurs at most once
discovery.interaction_graph: one module edge for every nonempty shared-variable set
admission: the module interaction graph is a forest
every shared variable belongs to at most two discovered modules
every module boundary has size at most floor(log2 L)
all modules are AFFINE_GF2 or SINGLE_HEAD_HORN

constructive_theorem: For every admitted raw factor instance of encoding size L, module discovery, a verified derived variable vtree, exact bottom-up composition, SAT witness recovery, UNSAT replay, and total certificate construction run in sum_M 2^{|B_M|} poly(L_M), hence polynomial under |B_M| <= floor(log2 L).
not_a_new_parameter: The discovered maximum module boundary is an explicit bounded-interface condition on an acyclic module join graph, not a renamed universal width measure.
forbidden_promotions: A derived vtree witness has polynomial standard factor width
Arbitrary CNF admits the discovered module forest
A supplied module partition or decomposition is free
A cyclic module graph is intrinsically hard
Multi-producer Horn is impossible in every richer representation
Finite exhaustive validation proves the theorem
This restricted theorem resolves P versus NP
claim_boundary: C040 discovers and compiles an acyclic logarithmic-interface portfolio class only. The load-bearing proof object is the module-forest dynamic program; the derived variable vtree is a verified embedding witness, not a universal width certificate.
